title: Reporting manager: any user can be picked; no hierarchy view
sub: TAVI CRM (staging-crm, tenant NDC-Staging) vs Zoho CRM (help docs)

panels.caption: Setup → Users → test user 1 (profile User) → Reporting manager list (opened, not saved)
Reporting Hierarchy on users (help docs)
text: The reporting manager is chosen from a list that only shows users in a higher role.
The user details page has a "Reporting Hierarchy" section with the manager and the direct reports.
Deleting a user with subordinates asks to move them to an equal or higher role, or leave them with no manager.

rows.b: Only a higher role can be manager
rows.tavi: List = all 9 other users (incl. test user 2, same User rank, and Supervisors / Managers); code filters only "not self"
Still "Reporting manager (user ID) — Paste a user ID"; the page only exists in Reporting mode (Role mode redirects to /settings)
